project: Digital Banking System — Secure Hybrid Cloud Migration Simulation
disclaimer: This risk register is an academic simulation artifact for evaluating cloud migration governance and security controls. It does not represent a real commercial banking risk assessment or claim production compliance.

risks.title: Unauthorized internal access to core banking subsystems
risks.description: An internal actor or compromised credential attempts to execute unauthorized privileged operations (e.g. KYC overrides, ledger modifications, unauthenticated fund transfers) bypassing role constraints.
risks.mitigation: Enforce strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication (MFA) for sensitive actions, and continuous session validation.
risks.monitoring_indicator: Rate of unauthorized access rejection events (RBAC_DENIED / MFA_FAILED).

risks.title: Sensitive data routed to public cloud tier
risks.description: RESTRICTED (PII, credentials, KYC) or CONFIDENTIAL (transactions, accounts) data inadvertently or erroneously routed to the public cloud elastic zone, causing regulatory violation.
risks.mitigation: Automated deterministic data classification at the API Gateway with strict policy precedence and automated violation interception (R2 alert).
risks.monitoring_indicator: Sensitive-to-public routing violation count (zero tolerance: must be 0 in clean runs).

risks.title: Cloud provider dependency and multi-tenant control risk
risks.description: Over-reliance on public cloud vendor hypervisor, unannounced API deprecations, multi-tenant side-channel risks, or lack of direct administrative oversight.
risks.mitigation: Confine core banking databases and confidential transactional logic to the private cloud tier; treat public cloud strictly as an elastic processing zone for non-sensitive workloads.
risks.monitoring_indicator: Percentage of critical banking transactions decoupled from public cloud infrastructure.

risks.title: Key-management and cryptographic lifecycle failure
risks.description: Failure in cryptographic key rotation, corrupted ciphertexts, simulated key store unavailability, or transmission of unencrypted payloads across the hybrid interconnect.
risks.mitigation: Simulated envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit) with mandatory interconnect cryptographic overhead and key validity checks.
risks.monitoring_indicator: Cryptographic failure rate and interconnect encryption verification status.

risks.title: Public cloud service outage or traffic exhaustion
risks.description: Sudden burst traffic, DDoS attacks, or public cloud zone outages causing severe queue build-up and latency inflation.
risks.mitigation: Automated public cloud autoscaling (Stage 5), graceful connection draining, and failover isolation to protect private cloud operations.
risks.monitoring_indicator: P95 response time, public queue depth, and drop rate under peak and burst workloads.

risks.title: Data residency and cross-border governance violation
risks.description: Transferring sovereign citizen banking records (RESTRICTED) across external regulatory boundaries or storing PII in non-compliant public availability zones.
risks.mitigation: Geographic boundary policy enforcement keeping all customer identity and account balance ledgers pinned to on-premise/private cloud storage.
risks.monitoring_indicator: Data residency audit log checks and cross-tier data export alerts.
